apiInfo.biography: 字巨高，沛郡谯县（今安徽省亳州市）人。东汉大臣，大长秋曹腾的养子，曹操之父亲。门荫入仕，历任司隶校尉、鸿胪卿、大司农，位列九卿，位高权重。中平四年（187年），靠着贿赂中官，出任太尉，位列三公。中平五年（188年），受累于黄巾之乱，坐罪免官。兴平元年（194年），投奔兖[yǎn]州牧曹操，遇害于徐州。
apiInfo.characteristic: 控制自己的体力上限以发挥曹嵩的最强实力。

skills.name: 礼赂
skills.text: 摸牌阶段，你可以改为将手牌摸至体力上限（至多摸至五张），然后交给一名其他角色至少一张手牌，若你首次以此法交出牌或交出的牌数大于上次以此法交出的牌数，你增加1点体力上限并回复1点体力。

skills.name: 翊正
skills.text: 结束阶段，你可以选择一名其他角色，然后直到你的下回合开始，当其造成伤害或回复体力时，若其体力上限小于你，你减少1点体力上限，然后此伤害值或回复值+1。

interpretation: Lilu replaces the entire native normal draw; it draws only up to min(MaxHp,5), never discarding surplus hand cards. At least one current physical hand card must be given to one other living recipient.

Every actual Lilu gift records its count, including equal and smaller gifts. The first actual gift, or a gift strictly greater than the immediately previous actual gift, grants exactly one maximum HP followed by one real recovery. The owner-wide history survives later skill loss and reacquisition.

A paid gift owns its movement and subsequent benefits in its ProgramSkillFrame; recipient death or source skill loss during a paid movement child cannot repay the gift or erase its earned benefit. A dead owner cannot gain maximum HP/recover.

Yizheng grants a duration ending at the next actual donor turn start, including an extra or face-down skipped turn. Losing the source skill does not revoke an already issued grant; dead donors cannot make new maximum-HP payments. A payment already made still increases its original amount after child returns.

Damage support is applied once per distinct native before-damage window, including a new chained target if the donor still satisfies the strict maximum-HP comparison. It never reapplies a paid invoice when the same pending window resumes.

Recovery support applies to the final prepared recipient after redirect choice and before HP delta. Positive requests with a living wounded recipient are eligible. The donor maximum HP is reduced before health-change children, then the same frozen requested recovery amount increases once.

The official texts contain no separate death/skill-loss or chain FAQ; the duration and issued-effect handling above follow the existing engine convention and the unqualified official damage/recovery trigger.
validation: Native gifts compare every immediately previous actual gift count. Issued support survives source loss, pays maximum-HP children once, expires at the next own turn, and follows the final recovery recipient after replacement.
